set.approach: The Spring Slabs are a sandstone crag at the Oasis, on private land entered through a gate; the local climbers' coalition handles access. From there a trail leads to the slabs. Gobi takes the right-most slab line.

review.notes: Area pages: gate, private land, follow the trail; route page: right-most slab line.
